# Original map pack fixtures

Orchard and River are independently declared original 7×7 test geometries,
covered by this repository's Apache-2.0 licence and authored for these tests.
They include no Saturn/Power graphics, audio, extracted bytes or fidelity claims.
Their manifests exercise separate namespaces and exact file hashes.

They are deliberately small fixtures for the production pack validator, registry,
MapManager and hosted-room tests, not replacements for the game's default map.
